review: They somewhat fixed the inability to reach the Monopoly game mode when there is a recent order showing in the app, by often having it on the home screen in the What's New section -- but sometimes it's not. I'm giving three stars because the effort was there, and if I see it consistently available, I might bump it up to four. Better would be if they put a link to it the actual View Receipt page. Keeping it easy to play will keep us ordering more!
